question_sentence: How much did President Trump pledge to pay every American adult if Republicans win the midterm elections?
evidence: President Donald Trump vowed to pay every American adult $5,000 if Republicans retain control of the House and Senate – an extraordinary promise that would amount to effectively trying to buy votes to keep his party in power.

question_sentence: Which milestone did Earth reach in August?
choices: Most active hurricane month on record
evidence: Earth just had its hottest August on record and tied the benchmark for the hottest month ever recorded since at least 1940, according to the Copernicus Climate Change Service.

question_sentence: An Amazon cargo plane recently overran a runway at which airport?
evidence: At least five people are dead after an Amazon cargo aircraft overran the runway during a landing at Miami International Airport. New black box data shows alarms sounded as a pilot warned that the plane was traveling too fast before the crash.

question_sentence: Which day marks the official end of summer?
evidence: Labor Day may have been America’s unofficial end of summer, but the season isn’t technically over just yet. Meteorological fall began on September 1, but astronomical summer sticks around until the autumnal equinox on September 22.

question_sentence: What was stolen in a $240 million heist that led to a guilty plea this week?
evidence: A 22-year-old man pleaded guilty on Tuesday to teaming up with friends to steal nearly $240 million in bitcoin from a Washington, DC, resident — one of the largest cryptocurrency thefts in US history.

question_sentence: How many years have passed since the terror attacks on 9/11?
evidence: This week marks 25 years since the attacks on September 11, 2001. Vigils, memorials and moments of remembrance were held across the country this week to honor the thousands of people who lost their lives and the first responders who rushed to help.
